clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for cast iron steps for manholes.

clauses.title: Material – Suitable quality
clauses.text: 2. Material -  Suitable quality of grey cast iron as specified.

clauses.title: Patterns
clauses.text: 3.1 Patterns Pattern 1 — Minimum weight  4.5 kg  (see 1A) Pattern 2 —  Minimum weight  5.3 kg  (see 1B)

clauses.title: Portion of step projecting
clauses.text: 3.2 Portion of step projecting from the wall of the man hole shall have a raised chequred design. SUMMARY OF IS 5455 : 1969 CAST IRON STEPS FOR MANHOLES

clauses.title: Coating – Shall be
clauses.text: 5. Coating -  Shall be coated with a material having tar base or with a black bituminous composition or cashew-nut shell liquid. The coating shall be smooth and tenacious. It shall not flow when exposed to a temperature of temperature of 63°C and shall not brittle as to chip of at a temperature of o°C.

clauses.title: Test – shall with
clauses.text: 6. Test -  shall with stand  a load of  225 kg at a point at the centre of the front tread for 1 minute All dimensions in millimetres.
